title: The Almost Finite--Purely Infinite Dichotomy for Minimal Amenable Ample Groupoids
summary: We answer, in the principal setting, a question of Matui on the almost finite--purely infinite dichotomy for minimal amenable ample groupoids. We prove that a second-countable Hausdorff minimal principal topologically amenable ample groupoid with Cantor unit space is strongly almost finite if and only if it admits an invariant probability measure; if no such measure exists, then it is purely infinite.
